data.name: SpoolerCallFailed
data.value: The Windows print spooler call '{0}' failed for printer '{1}': {2}
data.comment: {0} is the Win32 function name, {1} the printer name, {2} the Windows error description.

data.name: SpoolerCallFailedWithoutPrinter
data.value: The Windows print spooler call '{0}' failed: {1}
data.comment: {0} is the Win32 function name, {1} the Windows error description. For calls not about one printer, such as listing printers.

data.name: ExplainedSpoolerError
data.comment: {0} is the explanation, such as SpoolerNotRunning; {1} the failed call, from SpoolerCallFailed.

data.name: NoErrorReported
data.value: Windows gave no reason.
data.comment: Used instead of the Windows description when a call failed without setting an error code.

data.name: SpoolerNotRunning
data.value: The Windows Print Spooler service isn't running. Start it, for example with 'net start spooler' as an administrator.

data.name: PrintServerUnreachable
data.value: The print server sharing this printer can't be reached.

data.name: AccessDenied
data.value: Windows denied access: the account running the application may not be allowed to use or manage this printer.

data.name: PrinterRemoved
data.value: The printer has been removed from Windows.

data.name: DriverRefusesRawData
data.value: The printer's driver doesn't accept raw printer data.

data.name: DriverNotInstalled
data.value: The printer's driver isn't installed.

data.name: JobDeletedWhileSending
data.value: The job was deleted from the print queue while it was being sent.

data.name: CancelledByDriverDialog
data.value: The printer driver's request was cancelled, for example by closing its Save dialog. Virtual printers such as Microsoft Print to PDF need PrintOptions.OutputFile in applications that run without a user interface.

data.name: PathNotFound
data.value: Windows can't find a file or folder. If PrintOptions.OutputFile is set, check that its folder exists.

data.name: DiskFull
data.value: The disk used by the print spooler, or by the output file, is full.

data.name: DocumentFormatNotSupported
data.value: The Windows print spooler adapter cannot print '{0}' documents.
data.comment: {0} is the document format, such as Pdf.

data.name: PrinterNoLongerAvailable
data.value: The printer '{0}' could no longer be found.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name.

data.name: IppJobPrinterNotFound
data.value: The job '{0}' went straight to the IPP printer of the Windows queue '{1}', which wasn't found on the network to ask about it. It may be switched off or asleep; try again once it is on.
data.comment: {0} is the job ID, which starts ipp:; {1} the queue name.

data.name: IppPrinterUriInvalid
data.value: The IPP URI '{1}' for the Windows queue '{0}' must be an absolute ipp, ipps, http or https URI, such as ipp://192.168.1.20/ipp/print.
data.comment: {0} is the queue name from WindowsOptions.IppPrinterUris, {1} the URI given.

data.name: IppCredentialsWithoutUserName
data.value: Credentials in WindowsOptions.IppCredentials or IppPrinterCredentials have no user name. Set its UserName, or leave them unset to send none.
data.comment: Raised when the Windows print system is created with PrintPdfOverIpp on.

data.name: IppCredentialsUserNameHasColon
data.value: A user name in WindowsOptions.IppCredentials or IppPrinterCredentials can't contain ':', which HTTP Basic authentication uses to separate it from the password.
data.comment: Raised when the Windows print system is created with PrintPdfOverIpp on.

data.name: IppPrinterCredentialsUriInvalid
data.value: '{0}' in WindowsOptions.IppPrinterCredentials isn't an absolute ipp or ipps URI.
data.comment: {0} is the key given.

data.name: VendorOptionNotSupported
data.value: The Windows print spooler doesn't support the vendor option '{0}'. It supports {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the key, such as windows:paper; {1} the supported keys, such as windows:devmode and windows:print-ticket.

data.name: DevModeNotBase64
data.value: The vendor option windows:devmode must be a DEVMODE encoded in base64.

data.name: DevModeInvalid
data.value: The vendor option windows:devmode isn't a DEVMODE: it has {0} bytes, but says its public part has {1} and the driver's data {2}. Save the whole DEVMODE from the printer's driver.
data.comment: {0} is the decoded length, {1} dmSize, {2} dmDriverExtra.

data.name: PrintTicketApiMissing
data.value: The printer '{0}' can't use Print Tickets or Print Capabilities: this Windows doesn't have the Print Ticket API (prntvpt.dll). {1}
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the runtime's message about the missing library or function.

data.name: PrintCapabilitiesUnreadable
data.value: The driver of the printer '{0}' gave Print Capabilities that can't be read: {1}
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the XML parser's message.

data.name: PrintSchemaRootUnexpected
data.value: The document's root element is {0}, not {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the root element's name, {1} the one expected, both with their namespace in braces.

data.name: PrintSchemaDocumentEmpty
data.value: The document has no root element.

data.name: VendorFeatureOptionUnavailable
data.value: The printer '{0}' rules out the option '{1}' for the vendor option '{2}': the device or an administrator doesn't allow it, and the driver would print with another instead. It offers {3}.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the value given, {2} the key, {3} the values the printer offers, separated by commas.

data.name: VendorParameterRange
data.comment: {0} and {1} are a number's lowest and highest values, or VendorParameterNoLimit.

data.name: VendorParameterNoLimit
data.value: no limit
data.comment: Stands for a missing lowest or highest value in VendorParameterRange.

data.name: VendorFeatureNameInvalid
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' must name a feature or parameter as prefix:name after windows:feature: or windows:parameter:, such as windows:feature:psk:PageOutputQuality, and have a value.
data.comment: {0} is the key.

data.name: VendorFeatureUnknown
data.value: The printer '{0}' has no feature or parameter '{1}' (vendor option '{2}'). The printer's capabilities list its vendor options.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the feature or parameter name, such as ns0000:JobImageType, {2} the key.

data.name: VendorFeatureOptionUnknown
data.value: The printer '{0}' has no option '{1}' for the vendor option '{2}'. It offers {3}.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the value given, {2} the key, {3} the values the printer offers, separated by commas.

data.name: VendorParameterOutOfRange
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' must be a whole number from {1} for the printer '{2}', not '{3}'.
data.comment: {0} is the key, {1} the range, such as "1 to 99", {2} the printer name, {3} the value given.

data.name: VendorFeatureSetByTypedOption
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' sets what PrintOptions.{1} sets for this job. Use PrintOptions.{1} on its own.
data.comment: {0} is the key, {1} the PrintOptions property, such as MediaSize or Copies.

data.name: PrintTicketNotXml
data.value: The vendor option windows:print-ticket must be a Print Ticket in XML: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the XML parser's message.

data.name: PrintTicketNotPrintTicket
data.value: The vendor option windows:print-ticket must be a Print Ticket, whose root element is PrintTicket in the namespace {1}, but its root element is '{0}'.
data.comment: {0} is the root element's name, with its namespace in braces if it has one; {1} the Print Schema Framework namespace.

data.name: PrintTicketRefused
data.value: The printer '{0}' refused the vendor option windows:print-ticket: {1}
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the reason the Print Ticket API gave.

data.name: PrintTicketCallFailed
data.value: The printer '{0}' couldn't apply the vendor option windows:print-ticket: {1} failed with 0x{2}. {3}
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the Print Ticket API function, {2} its HRESULT in hexadecimal, {3} Windows's description of it.

data.name: MediaSizeNotListed
data.value: The printer '{0}' can't print on {1} ({2}): its driver doesn't list that paper size. Choose one of the sizes in the printer's capabilities.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the size's display name, such as A4, {2} its PWG name, such as iso_a4_210x297mm.

data.name: InputTrayNotListed
data.value: The printer '{0}' has no tray '{1}' (ID {2}): its driver doesn't list it. Choose one of the trays in the printer's capabilities.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the tray's name, such as Manual Feed, {2} its ID.

data.name: DriverDropsRawData
data.value: The printer '{0}' can't print raw data: its driver, {1}, accepts the job but writes nothing. Send a PDF instead.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the driver name, such as Microsoft Print To PDF.

data.name: DriverPrintsTextOnly
data.value: The printer '{0}' can't print PDFs: its driver, {1}, prints text only, and a PDF is printed as page images, which would stop its queue with an error. Send raw data, such as plain text or the printer's own language, instead.
data.comment: {0} is the printer name, {1} the driver name, such as Generic / Text Only.

data.name: RawCopiesNeedSeekableStream
data.value: Printing {0} copies of raw data needs a stream that can seek, so the data can be sent again for each copy. Use a seekable stream, such as a file or memory stream, or submit one copy at a time.
data.comment: {0} is the number of copies asked for. Raw data bypasses the printer driver, which would otherwise make the copies.

data.name: PdfNeedsRasterizer
data.value: Printing PDF documents on Windows needs a PDF rasteriser. Add the Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium package and call AddLatiprimerePdfium(), or pass a rasteriser to WindowsPrintSystemFactory.Create().

data.name: ImageNeedsRasterizer
data.value: Printing images and text on Windows needs a PDF rasteriser, as each is laid out as a PDF. Add the Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium package and call AddLatiprimerePdfium(), or pass a rasteriser to WindowsPrintSystemFactory.Create().

data.name: WindowsOnly
data.value: The Windows print spooler is only available on Windows.
